# Do boss-aware knobs reduce damage from the amusing, beetle-queen and masher bosses?

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | bosses |
| Result | inconclusive |
| Created | L2.I3 |
| Updated | L2.I7 |

## Hypothesis

distrustBossRange 220, bossOfferRange 220, bossDashRange 200 and bossDashThreshold 0.3 cut boss damage taken and dash near bosses without cutting kills, against the default on the same gym.

## Method

Gym seeker-nm1-100s, 200 s, boss knobs only against control L2.I2.G4 (damage by boss: amusing 3.2, queen 7.8, masher 59.7, health 120/120). Read per-boss damage, dashes near bosses and model call counts. The earlier minute-5 boss-knob test used a thin build, so treat this as a first look.

## Findings

1:40 seeker gym (L2.I3.G5): boss damage 31 against 71, one game each. From 5:00 to 10:00 on the seed 31 build (L2.I6.G4 and G5) both arms lived: boss knobs 131 damage, control 91, 0 dashes in both, so the knobs did not help. Boss damage was small in both. The first look at the opening gym stays a lead, but boss knobs are not worth adding to the playbook.
